description: This file defines an Android activity called RegisterActivity responsible for handling user registration. It sets up UI components, interacts with an auth repository to register new users, and provides feedback via Toast messages.

classes.name: RegisterActivity
classes.description: An Android activity for user registration, involving input fields for name, email, password, and a register button that triggers registration logic in a coroutine.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and defines the registration button click handler.
